description: This file defines FastAPI routes for managing blog posts, including creation, reading, updating, and deleting posts with database interaction using SQLAlchemy.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Model representing a blog post, used for database interactions.

methods.name: create_post( post: schemas.PostCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db), current_user=Depends(auth_utils.get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new blog post, generating a slug from the title and username.

methods.name: read_all_posts(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 20, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all posts.

methods.name: read_post(slug: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a single post identified by its slug.

methods.name: update_post( slug: str, updated: schemas.PostCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db), current_user=Depends(auth_utils.get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates a post if the current user is the author.

methods.name: delete_post( slug: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db), current_user=Depends(auth_utils.get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes a post if the current user is the author.

ctags.name: read_all_posts
ctags.pattern: /^async def read_all_posts(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 20, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get/
ctags.signature: (skip: int = 0, limit: int = 20, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db))

ctags.name: read_post
ctags.pattern: /^async def read_post(slug: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db)):$/

ctags.name: update_post
ctags.signature: ( slug: str, updated: schemas.PostCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(database.get_db), current_user=Depends(auth_utils.get_current_user), )
